text: 近期，全球资本市场波动加大。北京乐瑞资产管理有限公司表示，对于资本市场而言，中国制造业的全球竞争力，是优质企业持续创造价值的重要基础；宏观政策的保驾护航，则有助于扩大有效需求，为经济提供更强的支撑。该机构强调，“在市场短期波动的过程中，更应该坚定的以更长期的视角看待经济和市场。看到中国不断提升的产业竞争力、持续成长的经济新动能和积极有为的宏观政策，我们有充分理由保持定力、着眼长远，对中国市场和中国资产的长期价值保持信心。”（财联社）
text_en: Recently, global capital market volatility has increased. Beijing LeRui Asset Management Co., Ltd. stated that for capital markets, the global competitiveness of China's manufacturing industry is an important foundation for high-quality enterprises to continuously create value; macroeconomic policy support helps expand effective demand and provides stronger support for the economy. The institution emphasized that "during short-term market fluctuations, one should firmly view the economy and market from a longer-term perspective. Seeing China's continuously improving industrial competitiveness, growing new economic drivers, and proactive and effective macro policies, we have ample reason to maintain resolve, focus on the long term, and remain confident in the long-term value of the Chinese market and Chinese assets." (Cailianshe)
